descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S04 「每类浏览器流量各一个请求：Convex sync、auth HTTP action、静态资源、外链」 One request per browser traffic class: Convex sync, auth HTTP actions, static assets, outbound links

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Every network request the app makes (web, iOS and Android, in Hospital and Nursing Home) uses HTTPS. There is no plain-HTTP endpoint anywhere.（UAT OAT-02；UAT 4；TFA-92568 AC 4；TFA-92568 Eng 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress
  • U2 All traffic is encrypted in transit. This includes the live-dictation audio stream and the backend's calls to the AI and email providers (Bedrock, Vertex, OpenAI, SES).（UAT OAT-02；TFA-92568 AC 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given The deployed QA build in desktop Chrome with DevTools Network open. Not on and never with store-review-test-account@roundcompanion.com. Run only on the deployment Q8 names. The @roundai.test sign-in code comes from Tim running seed:issueTestOtp on that deployment.

When Trigger each class once: (1) Convex sync WebSocket (open the Hospital list and the Nursing Home list); (2) auth HTTP actions on .convex.site (request and verify a sign-in code); (3) web host static assets (hard reload); (4) Privacy Policy, Terms and BAA links. Live dictation is its own class, in S21.

Then Every class is https:// or wss://.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U1/U2 per class. Any class on http: or ws: = Fail, quoted with its URL.

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S04 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-02.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：dev。
